notes: RNA arm of a ribosome-profiling study: RNA fragmented and size selected 20-40 nt on PAGE -> assay_class other. All samples got chloramphenicol 2 min before harvest (profiling protocol); labelled abx_translation/acute, wild type kept as the comparison baseline (is_control true). csrA::kan is a transposon insertion, labelled deletion. Temperature and aeration not given.

growth_phase.q: Strains were grown in LB media to mid-exponential phase (OD600 = 0.5)

base_medium.q: Strains were grown in LB media

medium_class.q: Strains were grown in LB media

amino_acids_supplied.q: Strains were grown in LB media

assay_class.q: RNA was then fragmented with heat and alkalinity and size selected between 20 and 40 bases with denaturing PAGE

rrna_removal.q: rRNA was subtracted with the Ribozero Gram Negative Kit (Illumina)

mixed_organism.q: 5 biological replicates of ribosome protected fragments and paired RNA samples from wild type and csrA::kan mutant strains were analyzed

inducer_added.q: 5 biological replicates of ribosome protected fragments and paired RNA samples from wild type and csrA::kan mutant strains were analyzed

transcription_arrested.q: 5 biological replicates of ribosome protected fragments and paired RNA samples from wild type and csrA::kan mutant strains were analyzed

treatment.q: Samples were treated with 100ug/ml choramphenicol for 2 minutes

exposure.q: Samples were treated with 100ug/ml choramphenicol for 2 minutes
